get_notes_list: get all notes for the authenticated user with optional pagination support
search_notes_by_query: search notes by query string, view option, permission, order and direction filters
create_new_note: create a new note with title and data using the NoteForm model
get_note_by_id: retrieve a single note by its id with write access information
update_note_by_id: update an existing note by id and emit real-time note-events via websocket
